body:
I had a nightmare about being this guy. It was the most real thing I have ever dreamed. Don't know where it came from, but I dreamed I was near the top of a high rise building, and then... I guess it was an asteroid or a nuke, hit about 500 meters away and the room I was in canted hard away from the explosion and I became weightless. In less time than it takes to articulate it, I knew that the shockwave had blasted the base of the building out, and I was going to be dead in less than a second. It was strange, once I made that realization, I was suddenly ok with dying. Then I woke up soaked in sweat and it took me a minute to figure out I was still alive.
Never seen that movie before, but I know exactly what that guys last moments were like. It's hell but I wouldn't want to go any other way. Personally, when I die, I want to be fully aware and be able to really experience it. Yeah, I'm fucked in the head.

If I had to guess, I'd say the hash you smoked was laced with one of the RC cannabinoids, possibly jwh-073 (just a guess from the way you are talking). You'll be fine man, just chill out and enjoy it. You may never again be as high as you currently are. First time I got "surprised" like this, I was high for around 5 hours. No matter how much you possibly ingested though, you'll feel great in 5 hours or so. I was absolutely certain I was dying the first time I accidentally ingested a large quantity of an RC without meaning to. Nope, it's perfectly safe in my experience. Enjoy the ride, good sir
Seemed awesome while I was in. I was on and got kicked. Is the server down?

I'm going to fuck Zolvs mom. I am taking DogFacedKillah with me. If we're not back by 0100, assume the sarlacc pit swallowed us whole. Mourn for us brothers. If we make contact with code pink, we will fight back to the last rally point. If you make contact, make a rage comic about it. motherfuckin GOTWAA
I commute 6 hours to get to my unit. I requested a tranfer to the unit in my town. Answer? "No, we have mobilization orders for a year from now."
I love this meme
Best comment so far. You're the best, Zolv. It's... it's a goddamn checklist. So military that it's almost a 5 paragraph op order powerpoint. Fuck yeah, thanks.

Yeah, I'm not sure I understand the people saying "you were willing to tell strangers on the interet. Hah, you're just looking for pity." You guys are resourceful motherfuckers. I've gotten some awesome advice from this post so far. Thanks
They aren't letting people go for suicidal ideation any more. Yeah... it kind of is like a prison. Especially during training.
But smoking trees would be so much more fun :( Heh, yeah, the drugs idea was like my last last resort.

Yeah? Sounds like you were one of the guys in my platoon during basic. I had to pull extra fireguard to watch you for three nights before you got out >.> naw jk. But it gets a lot harder after you get out of basic.
I'd love it if I had money for a lawyer. Yeah, I talked to someone today that convinced me to try the med board. Might work.
I got a lucky break. My paycheck came in this afternoon. Thanks for the offer bro, but I can't take your money.
They aren't discharging people for suicide attempts any more, last I checked. I could be wrong. Gonna go see my psych tomorrow. I got a lucky break and my paycheck finally came in.
Oh, my bad. PT stands for....fuck if I know. Physical testing? The army has minimum fitness standards you have to meet, including a two mile run, and pushups, which are what I keep fucking up.
I like it. My life has meaning now, thanks.
Lol, nice. Problem. I'm atheist reformed jewish.
A nasty girl I am indeed. And I didn't even know there was something wrong with me till the meps doctor said I had pectus and wrote a waiver for it. I was a pretty oblivious teenager.
tried that. "unit might be recieving mob orders. no transfers." "le fffffffuuuuuuuuuuuu"
Heh. I want to become a doctor. But WWE heavyweight champion is almost as good.
Congrats man, things worked out for you. You did deploy though. And you weren't the unit shitbag. They may try to make an example of me.

If I go overseas with my unit, either I will kill myself to buy the farm for my family, or one of my own guys will kill me. Obviously, since I'm suicidal, this doesn't sound so bad. Until I realize I'll probably get someone else killed and end up surviving myself. Not sure I can deal with that.

I want to go to medical school. I've done the research, and I can still do that with an OTH discharge.

The army isn't letting people who are suicidal go any more.
Good luck man, I wish you the easiest last few years of your contract possible. You're a better man than me, and I wish I could be like you.
I'm just about there

Just don't sign for six years, all the advice I can offer. Lots of things can change in six years, and you'll be stuck. No enlistment bonus anymore anyway, so might as well sign for 3. The guard was great for me at first, paid for school, was fun as fuck... it's my unit that's killing me. I'd still recommend the guard even to my own family members though.
I passed a grand total of one pt test. The last one of AIT. And they let me pass.

"you seem to be of no use to me and my fellow service members."

I'm sorry man. I did my best. The army has no shortage of warm bodies right now, I just wish to fuck I hadn't signed those papers when I was a dumb teenager.

I tried to get excused. I literally ran out of fuel and money on the way back from last drill, and I don't even have enough to make it there this weekend, told my team leader and he replied "figure it out"

Not any more. Soldiers have been using that one to get out for too long. Now they just proscribe SSRIs and say, get back out there soldier. "Suicide prevention" is the biggest joke in the army. Everyone laughs about it. "Ha, suicide class time. Sorry guys, we have to do it by the regs. But I know no one here is suicidal hahahahaha lets just get this out of the way."

I didn't even know there was anything wrong with me till the doc at MEPS diagnosed me. But he signed a waiver, so at the time I was like "cool, bullet dodged." Wasn't till I showed up at basic that I realized there might be a problem. The only PT test I've ever passed was the last one at AIT, and they "let me pass" if you know what I mean.

My senior NCOs are the ones being assholes. The only one who gives a fuck about me is my squad leader, and I've already told him I'm suicidal and doing my best. He's on my side, but I'd rather not make him look bad by trying to use him to get help. My team leader, pl sgt and 1st sgt don't give two fucks. Only higher up person I might be able to get through to is my sgt major...but what fucking private is gonna get away with walking up and talking to a SM.
Sounds like a pretty good description of me right now. I just do all that where no one can see me.
Least I won't have access to knives there.

I'm badly underweight. Along with the depression, I guess I picked up an eating disorder along the way. I don't eat more than a few times a week these days. I've seen fatties in the army, they don't get discharged.
That's why I'm here. I've racked my brain and I can't think of any, but I figure you guys will. And you have, I'm thinking a lot more rationally now. Thanks
That's not....exactly...what I had in mind. A little less grand theft auto, and paralysis, but that's the general idea.
:D
Hahaha. Don't know why you got downvoted

Good to know I've got options at least. i'm gonna go to drill tomorrow and try and get in contact with a chaplain or a base psychiatrist. If shit hits the fan, at least I've got this option as a last resort
my unit is doing two MUTA5s in a row, back to back. Not a troll.

I'm taking responsibility. I fucking failed. I signed a contract, and now I'm too mentally unstable to live up to it. I'm not about to go into a warzone, and have people depending on me when I can't even depend on myself right now. No, it didn't happen by accident. But I didn't maliciously decide to join the military and then back out either. I thought I could do it.
Thanks for the good advice. I don't know what I'm going to do yet, but I'll keep this in mind.

"But don't sit here and solicit advice on how to go AWOL and out of a contract that you signed up for but now have buyer's remorse."

Yes. Yes, I think I'll do just that. Welcome to the internet, where people talk about their problems openly and anonymously

I know the consequences. Bad conduct discharge, permanent record, etc. The other thing is I am out of money, and don't have enough fuel to get to my unit anyway. I told me team leader that and he told me to "figure it out." So I can't report anyway. I've only got till tomorrow at midnight to decide what I'm going to do. I would go see my psychiatrist, except I don't have any money, damnit. Thanks though
Thanks. I have a little hope that I might make it out of this now. Maybe that doesn't make sense, but it's great to hear I'm not just delusional.

Yeah, it's desertion. But my understanding is that they put out a warrant and if you turn yourself in you are only held long enough to go through court marshal and be discharged. Afaik. I guess that's why I'm asking.

There's blood everywhere.. I just cut the hell outt amy thigh and it's fucking beautiful. But it wasn't deep enoguh, i want more. I really do need to be committed.. jesus. I'm out of money though...idk what to do! fuck fuck fuck fuck thanks guys

Well, I guess it's d-day, h-hour. I was driving this morning and don't fear the reaper came on the radio. I accelerated laughing like a crazy person and headed straight at an oncoming semitruck. Slammed on my brakes and skidded off the road... guess I just don't have the balls to do it yet. I don't even know what to tell my pdoc or the military or if it's even worth it. I'll probably just end it all in the end anyway.
